goal: Issue #6: public status page at the service root and multi-user read-only admin panel with a CLI-managed superuser.

decisions.events: persist daily counters only (delivered / failed), no event content
decisions.frontend: React SPA built with Vite, served by Fastify from the same container
decisions.roles: superuser manages admin users; other admins are read-only viewers

items.goals: React/Vite frontend skeleton served by Fastify; /health checks the database; daily event delivery counters; public page at / with health and aggregate statistics.
items.scope: frontend build pipeline, Dockerfile, health check, event counters table and increments, public stats JSON endpoint, status page UI
items.nonGoals: admin panel, authentication, per-portal data, event content
acceptance: GET / shows service and database health and aggregate counts
If the database is down, the page and /health report it
The page and its endpoint expose no secrets, tokens or portal hosts

items.goals: Multi-user admin panel: CLI sets the superuser password; superuser manages admin users; all admins browse portals, applications, token metadata and event counters read-only with search by fields.
items.scope: admin users and sessions tables, CLI command, login/logout, session cookies, rate limit, admin JSON API, admin UI tables with search, docs
items.nonGoals: editing or deleting service data, token values or hashes, SSO, fine-grained permissions
acceptance: Admin panel refuses login until a superuser exists
CLI sets the superuser password from a hidden prompt or stdin only
A non-superuser admin cannot manage users
Each table filters by its fields
